expect.means: The quest script writes this line at every new game and every load. If it is missing, the quest never ran.
Stage 10 was set when the player first reached a spaceport.
Stage 20 was set when the player read the letter.
Stage 30 was set and the quest finished.

forbid.means: A stage was set before the stage that must come first, for example by a console setstage.
